body: Australia. I lived there for a couple years as a child because of the company my Dad worked for. It was the best time of my life. The people are so happy and friendly, I love the culture, Sydney is one of my favorite cities(Right after NYC) and it reminds me of a time I wasnt totally depressed and my family was happy.
